title: LiteLLM — SpendLogs (données exactes par requête)
description: Données exactes par requête (LiteLLM_SpendLogs). Identités pseudonymisées par défaut (variable « Identités »). Section du haut : test de l'hypothèse « les gros prompts ralentissent les autres ».

list.name: identite
list.label: Identités
list.description: Pseudonyme par défaut. Le mode nominatif ne protège rien à lui seul : restreindre l'accès au dossier Grafana.

panels.title: Hypothèse : les très gros prompts ralentissent-ils les autres ?
Petites requêtes : TTFT avec / sans gros prompt d'un autre utilisateur en lecture (même stack)
panels.description: Le test central. Petite requête : prompt < $petit tokens, streamée. « Avec » : un prompt ≥ $gros tokens d'une autre clé était entre son début et son premier token sur la même stack pendant que la petite requête était en cours (la gêne touche le premier token ET l'écriture : comparer aussi la durée). Un écart net (×2 sur la médiane, ×3 sur le p95, ≥ 30 requêtes de chaque côté) confirme l'hypothèse ; aucun écart l'infirme.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT s."startTime" AS st, s."endTime" AS en, s."completionStartTime" AS ft, COALESCE(s.prompt_tokens, 0) AS pt,
         rtrim(s.api_base, '/') AS api_base, s.api_key  -- « …/v1/ » (non streamé) = « …/v1 » (streamé)
  FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
), h AS (  -- gros prompts : fenêtre de lecture = début -> premier token (ou fin si non streamé)
  SELECT st, CASE WHEN ft > st AND ft <= en THEN ft ELSE en END AS pe, api_base, api_key FROM r WHERE pt >= $gros
), p AS (  -- petites requêtes streamées, marquées si un gros prompt d'une AUTRE clé est en lecture sur la même stack
  SELECT r.st, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.ft - r.st)) AS ttft, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.en - r.st)) AS dur,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM h WHERE h.api_base = r.api_base AND h.api_key IS DISTINCT FROM r.api_key
                                    AND h.st < r.en AND h.pe > r.st) AS gros
  FROM r WHERE r.pt < $petit AND r.ft > r.st AND r.ft < r.en
)
SELECT CASE WHEN gros THEN 'Avec gros prompt en lecture' ELSE 'Sans gros prompt en lecture' END AS "Petites requêtes",
  count(*) AS "Requêtes",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ttft) AS "TTFT p50",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ttft) AS "TTFT p95",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dur) AS "Durée p50",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dur) AS "Durée p95"
FROM p GROUP BY gros ORDER BY gros

panels.title: TTFT par taille de prompt
panels.description: Un gros prompt a naturellement un TTFT élevé (temps de lecture). C'est la ligne des petites requêtes qui mesure la gêne subie ; « Part tokens in » montre qui consomme la capacité de lecture.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.prompt_tokens, 0) < $petit THEN '1 · petite (< $petit)'
            WHEN s.prompt_tokens < GREATEST(32000, $petit) THEN '2 · < 32 000'
            WHEN s.prompt_tokens < $gros THEN '3 · < $gros'
            ELSE '4 · gros (≥ $gros)' END AS "Taille du prompt",
  count(*) AS "Requêtes", count(DISTINCT s.api_key) AS "Clés",
  sum(s.prompt_tokens)::float / NULLIF(sum(sum(s.prompt_tokens)) OVER (), 0) AS "Part tokens in",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s."completionStartTime" - s."startTime")))
    FILTER (WHERE s."completionStartTime" > s."startTime" AND s."completionStartTime" < s."endTime") AS "TTFT p50",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s."completionStartTime" - s."startTime")))
    FILTER (WHERE s."completionStartTime" > s."startTime" AND s."completionStartTime" < s."endTime") AS "TTFT p95"
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: TTFT p95 des petites requêtes vs volume des gros prompts
panels.description: Si les courbes « avec gros en lecture » et les barres montent ensemble, la corrélation est visible dans le temps. Zoomer sur un ralentissement signalé.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT s."startTime" AS st, s."endTime" AS en, s."completionStartTime" AS ft, COALESCE(s.prompt_tokens, 0) AS pt,
         rtrim(s.api_base, '/') AS api_base, s.api_key  -- « …/v1/ » (non streamé) = « …/v1 » (streamé)
  FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
), h AS (  -- gros prompts : fenêtre de lecture = début -> premier token (ou fin si non streamé)
  SELECT st, CASE WHEN ft > st AND ft <= en THEN ft ELSE en END AS pe, api_base, api_key FROM r WHERE pt >= $gros
), p AS (  -- petites requêtes streamées, marquées si un gros prompt d'une AUTRE clé est en lecture sur la même stack
  SELECT r.st, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.ft - r.st)) AS ttft, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.en - r.st)) AS dur,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM h WHERE h.api_base = r.api_base AND h.api_key IS DISTINCT FROM r.api_key
                                    AND h.st < r.en AND h.pe > r.st) AS gros
  FROM r WHERE r.pt < $petit AND r.ft > r.st AND r.ft < r.en
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(st, $__interval),
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ttft) FILTER (WHERE NOT gros) AS "TTFT p95 petites (sans gros en lecture)",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ttft) FILTER (WHERE gros) AS "TTFT p95 petites (avec gros en lecture)"
FROM p GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s."startTime", $__interval), sum(s.prompt_tokens) AS "Tokens des gros prompts"
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime") AND s.prompt_tokens >= $gros
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Requêtes simultanées par clé (dimensionnement de max_parallel_requests)
panels.description: « Minutes > N » : minutes d'activité où la clé aurait été bridée par une limite LiteLLM à N requêtes simultanées. Choisir la limite qui ne bride que les usages extrêmes.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT s.api_key AS kid, s."startTime" AS ts, 1 AS d FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.api_key, s."endTime", -1 FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
), c AS (
  SELECT kid, ts, d, sum(d) OVER (PARTITION BY kid ORDER BY ts, d ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS conc FROM ev
), iv AS (  -- chaque niveau de concurrence tient jusqu'à l'événement suivant
  SELECT kid, ts, lead(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY kid ORDER BY ts, d) AS nxt, conc FROM c
), m AS (   -- niveau max par minute, minutes sans événement comprises
  SELECT kid, g.mn, max(conc) AS mx
  FROM iv, generate_series(date_trunc('minute', ts), COALESCE(nxt, ts), interval '1 minute') AS g(mn)
  WHERE conc > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2
), agg AS (
  SELECT kid, max(mx) AS pic, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY mx) AS p95, count(*) AS minutes,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE mx > 2) AS m2, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mx > 3) AS m3, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mx > 4) AS m4
  FROM m GROUP BY kid
)
SELECT CASE WHEN '$identite' = 'nominatif' THEN COALESCE(u.user_email, NULLIF(NULLIF(k.user_id, ''), 'None'), '(aucun)') ELSE 'user-' || left(md5(COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(k.user_id, ''), 'None'), agg.kid, '')), 6) END AS "Utilisateur",
       CASE WHEN '$identite' = 'nominatif' THEN COALESCE(k.key_alias, '(sans alias)') ELSE 'clé-' || left(md5(COALESCE(agg.kid, '')), 6) END AS "Clé",
       pic AS "Pic simultané", p95 AS "Simultané p95 (minutes actives)", minutes AS "Minutes actives",
       m2 AS "Minutes > 2", m3 AS "Minutes > 3", m4 AS "Minutes > 4"
FROM agg
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" k ON k.token = agg.kid
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_UserTable" u ON u.user_id = k.user_id
ORDER BY pic DESC, minutes DESC

panels.title: Les 20 plus gros prompts de la période
panels.description: Pour relier un ralentissement signalé (heure) à un événement précis.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s."startTime" AS "Début", CASE WHEN '$identite' = 'nominatif' THEN COALESCE(u.user_email, NULLIF(NULLIF(s."user", ''), 'None'), '(aucun)') ELSE 'user-' || left(md5(COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(s."user", ''), 'None'), s.api_key, '')), 6) END AS "Utilisateur", CASE WHEN '$identite' = 'nominatif' THEN COALESCE(k.key_alias, '(sans alias)') ELSE 'clé-' || left(md5(COALESCE(s.api_key, '')), 6) END AS "Clé", rtrim(s.api_base, '/') AS "Stack",
  s.prompt_tokens AS "Tokens in",
  CASE WHEN s."completionStartTime" > s."startTime" AND s."completionStartTime" < s."endTime"
       THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s."completionStartTime" - s."startTime")) END AS "TTFT",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s."endTime" - s."startTime")) AS "Durée"
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_UserTable" u ON u.user_id = s."user"
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" k ON k.token = s.api_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
ORDER BY s.prompt_tokens DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20

SELECT COALESCE(t.team_alias, s.team_id, '(sans team)') AS "Team",
  count(*) AS "Requêtes", count(DISTINCT s."user") AS "Utilisateurs",
  sum(s.prompt_tokens) AS "Tokens in", sum(s.completion_tokens) AS "Tokens out",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s."completionStartTime" - s."startTime"))) FILTER (WHERE s."completionStartTime" > s."startTime") AS "TTFT p95 (s)",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s."endTime" - s."startTime"))) AS "Durée p95 (s)"
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_TeamTable" t ON t.team_id = s.team_id
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_UserTable" u ON u.user_id = s."user"
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" k ON k.token = s.api_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT COALESCE(t.team_alias, s.team_id, '(sans team)') AS "Team", CASE WHEN '$identite' = 'nominatif' THEN COALESCE(u.user_email, NULLIF(NULLIF(s."user", ''), 'None'), '(aucun)') ELSE 'user-' || left(md5(COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(s."user", ''), 'None'), s.api_key, '')), 6) END AS "Utilisateur",
  CASE WHEN '$identite' = 'nominatif' THEN COALESCE(k.key_alias, '(sans alias)') ELSE 'clé-' || left(md5(COALESCE(s.api_key, '')), 6) END AS "Clé",
  count(*) AS "Requêtes", sum(s.prompt_tokens) AS "Tokens in", sum(s.completion_tokens) AS "Tokens out",
  round(avg(s.prompt_tokens)) AS "Prompt moyen",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s."completionStartTime" - s."startTime"))) FILTER (WHERE s."completionStartTime" > s."startTime") AS "TTFT p95 (s)",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s."endTime" - s."startTime"))) AS "Durée p95 (s)"
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_TeamTable" t ON t.team_id = s.team_id
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_UserTable" u ON u.user_id = s."user"
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" k ON k.token = s.api_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Requêtes par heure et par team

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s."startTime", '1h', 0), COALESCE(t.team_alias, s.team_id, '(sans team)') AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_TeamTable" t ON t.team_id = s.team_id
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_UserTable" u ON u.user_id = s."user"
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" k ON k.token = s.api_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: TTFT p95 par jour et par stack (api_base)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s."startTime", '1d', 0), rtrim(s.api_base, '/') AS metric,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s."completionStartTime" - s."startTime"))) AS value
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_TeamTable" t ON t.team_id = s.team_id
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_UserTable" u ON u.user_id = s."user"
LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" k ON k.token = s.api_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime") AND s."completionStartTime" > s."startTime"
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Concurrence estimée (requêtes simultanées, pic par 5 min)
panels.description: Reconstituée à partir de startTime/endTime de chaque requête : vraie concurrence vue par la gateway.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT "startTime" AS ts, 1 AS d FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "endTime", -1 FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
), c AS (SELECT ts, sum(d) OVER (ORDER BY ts, d) AS conc FROM ev)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '5m', 0), max(conc) AS "concurrence max"
FROM c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
